title: Completed control is stationary
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$ and every configuration $c$ of the unrestricted field loader on $x$ whose state is its completed reading control, one step of the loader leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration $c$ of the unrestricted loader on $x$
The state of $c$ is the completed reading control
replaced: Every configuration of the unrestricted loader in its completed reading control is left entirely unchanged by one step.
